Hi Evan — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the security questionnaire: 

Recap from our call:
- AuroraFin will evaluate Redwood for document summarization and private inference endpoints (no model training).
- Key compliance asks on your side: SOC 2 status, ability to sign a BAA for PHI, and data residency.

Questions / asks to help us start the SIG/CAIQ pathway: 
1) SOC 2: do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If not, can you share expected completion date (Type II in progress is fine).
2) PHI: will AuroraFin send PHI to the inference endpoints (yes/no)? If yes, do you require a BAA?
3) Hosting / residency: where will inference requests originate (AWS us-east-1 / eu-west-1 / other)? Any specific VPC/VPN constraints?
4) Preferred questionnaire: would you rather we complete the standard CAIQ or a custom SIG (full/abbreviated)? We can do a SIG Lite to move faster if you want quick coverage.

If you can send any existing deliverables (network diagram, current CAIQ/SIG answers, SOC 2 report), we’ll route to our security team for a tailored evidence ask. I’ve copied Jordan to coordinate the prefill and Rishi from security for any follow-ups.

Attachments: I can start a Redwood prefill template if helpful — will add to the thread once I have your hosting/dataflow files.

Proposed next steps:
- Evan: share SOC 2 status + network/dataflow (attach) by Wed 5/26
- Jordan: prepare the prefill template for SIG/CAIQ based on their answers
- Rishi: standby for evidence list (I’ll loop you after Evan replies)

Thanks — Soojin

--

Hi Soojin — great recap, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type I in Q4 2026 and are mid-audit for Type II. Expect final report in early Q3 2027 (no hard stop yet).
2) PHI: yes — some of our customers send PHI for redaction/summary. We will need a BAA in place before production access.
3) Hosting: inference traffic will originate from us-east-1 (AWS). We would prefer to keep logs and any persisted artifacts in the US.
4) Questionnaire: we typically prefer the full SIG (CAIQ) but are open to SIG Lite initially to speed things up as long as we get an evidence roadmap.

Attaching a simple dataflow/network diagram to help your team (attached: aurorafin-dataflow-v1.pdf). If you can share Redwood’s typical evidence asks and an initial prefill, we’ll reply with what we can provide immediately.

Thanks — Evan
